excerpt.en: Walk both campuses, meet teachers, and see learning in action.
excerpt.id: Jelajahi kedua kampus, temui guru, lihat pembelajaran langsung.

en: Join us for a morning of tours, classroom visits, and conversations with division leaders. No registration fee; bring your questions.
id: Ikuti pagi penuh tur, kunjungan kelas, dan percakapan dengan pemimpin divisi. Gratis; bawa pertanyaan Anda.

excerpt.en: Music, theatre, and visual art from every division.
excerpt.id: Musik, teater, dan seni rupa dari setiap divisi.

en: An evening of gamelan, choir, black-box theatre, and a gallery walk of student work.
id: Malam gamelan, paduan suara, teater black-box, dan galeri karya siswa.

excerpt.en: Meet our partners and fund student-led projects.
excerpt.id: Temui mitra kami dan danai proyek pimpinan siswa.

en: Student teams pitch their service projects; community members vote with micro-grants.
id: Tim siswa mempresentasikan proyek servis; komunitas memberikan hibah mikro.

excerpt.en: Admissions officers from 30+ universities visit campus.
excerpt.id: Petugas penerimaan dari 30+ universitas mengunjungi kampus.

en: Book slots through the counseling office. Open to Grades 10–12 and parents.
id: Pesan slot melalui kantor konseling. Terbuka untuk Kelas 10–12 dan orang tua.

excerpt.en: Celebrating 75 years with alumni, families, and friends.
excerpt.id: Merayakan 75 tahun bersama alumni, keluarga, dan sahabat.

en: A night of stories, performances, and the launch of the anniversary campaign highlights.
id: Malam cerita, pertunjukan, dan sorotan kampanye HUT.

excerpt.en: Cakrawala hosts regional teams for a season of competition.
excerpt.id: Cakrawala menjadi tuan rumah tim regional.

en: Come cheer our teams across soccer, basketball, and volleyball.
id: Dukung tim kami di sepak bola, basket, dan voli.
